Case Study

LinkedIn automation tool that helps you reach the right people the right way

Auto-rotate LinkedIn senders

Connect unlimited LinkedIn accounts for one flat fee and automatically rotate sending between them. Reach more leads and book more meetings, without losing that much-needed personal touch.

Import qualified leads

Run outbound and inbound-led campaigns. Import relevant LinkedIn contacts from Sales Navigator, Clay, RB2B, HubSpot, or any other tool.

Combine LinkedIn steps

Automate actions such as connection requests, messages, voice notes, and profile views. Use "If Connected" logic to segment current connections from new ones, making your outreach precise.

Manage replies in Unified Inbox

Handle all LinkedIn messages in one centralized inbox, without logging in and out of accounts all the time. Send voice notes from your desktop and reply on behalf of your colleagues.

Turn replies into revenue

Real-time data, sentiment analysis, and auto-tagged warm leads so your best leads never go cold.

Ridiculously easy to connect

Plug HeyReach into any GTM tool you already use and run LinkedIn outreach your way. No learning curve, no headaches.

See all integrations

Reach leads on autopilot

Let your AI agents run LinkedIn outreach end-to-end, while you focus on closing. Connect HeyReach to Claude, ChatGPT, OpenClay, and more.

Powerful API →
Flexible API and custom webhooks available to scale LinkedIn outreach your way.
HeyReach MCP →
HeyReach MCP allows you to connect with AI Agents that can make decisions for you, split lead lists, create LinkedIn campaigns with custom messages, tag replies by sentiment and send them to your CRM. Possibilities are endless!
HeyReach CLI →
Launch campaigns, write relevant messages, and measure pipeline — without leaving your command line or your Claude chat. Outbound that talks to your stack the way you actually work.

Run multichannel outreach

Native integrations with Instantly, Smartlead, and EmailBison that are simple to use. No lead slips through — and HeyReach even finds verified emails for you.

Clean HubSpot CRM sync

Every connection, message, and reply shows up automatically on your HubSpot contacts. Clean attribution, real ROI, zero manual logging — and yes, it's verified by HubSpot.

API built for builders

HeyReach API and webhooks let your team automate every step of LinkedIn outreach, connect proprietary systems, and build workflows that fit your exact process.

Connect any GTM tool

Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier, and whatever tool your stack runs on. Connect enrichment, automation, and outreach into one flow that moves deals forward.

Turn signals into pipeline

The moment someone visits your site, books a meeting, engages with an ad, or interacts with your posts — push them straight into HeyReach as a warm lead. No manual setup needed.
